title: Trade Run: Cinderspice to Nova Terra Central (Node Alpha board): ten cinderspice bought at Central Nexus, sold into Nova Terra's bid; XP, no credits
note: 2026-11-22 03:45 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-061 block MERCURY: missions that pay the trader's skills; tests.md, Trade Run missions). Node Alpha's board (data/missions/node_alpha_processing_station.json, 03:41 UTC): sell 10 cinderspice at Nova Terra Central; rewards trading 35 and piloting 160 XP, 0 cr. Central Nexus asks cinderspice 3,011 x 10, Nova Terra bids 3,017 x 10 (table books, 03:36 to 03:39 UTC): the goods cost about 500 cr a run in fees (1 percent each way) and the buy gives about 300 trading XP (1 XP per 100 cr bought, guidebook levelling). Road: Central Nexus, Node Alpha, Synchrony, Pherkad, GSC-0041, Antares, Homam, Furud, Nova Terra (8 jumps, 3 lawless, no pirate on our record in 24 hours). The runner accepts a mission by template_id only and a Trade Run has none on the board, so the first accept is by hand (rule F15) and every stop asks only_if_active: a pilot without the mission passes every stop and buys nothing. One ship (rule F37: one buyer, one ship three times). 2026-11-22 03:52 UTC (Mercury): the runner's active() reads only missions with a 32-hex id and a Trade Run's id is its name (trade_node_alpha_processing_station_nova_terra_central_cinderspice), so only_if_active passed every stop of the first run (RESULT 03:49 UTC: 3/3 stops, 0 cr). The gates are taken out and the route is once: it is flown only by the one pilot whose plan names it, after its accept by hand, and handed in by hand; the runner's fix is asked of the Fleet Admiral (requests.log).
